configuration.tokenizer: lowercase alphanumeric [a-z0-9]+, no stemming or stopword removal

metric_definitions.precision_at_k: unique retrieved relevant IDs / fixed k, including short result lists
metric_definitions.recall_at_k: unique retrieved relevant IDs / number of relevant IDs
metric_definitions.mean_reciprocal_rank: macro mean reciprocal rank of first relevant result within top k
metric_definitions.ndcg_at_k: binary DCG / ideal DCG; discount log2(rank+1)
metric_definitions.aggregation: unweighted macro mean across every case; none skipped

limitations: Corpus provided explicitly; verify its hashes against the intended canonical inputs.
Empty-content chunks receive zero vectors; original source-record corpora contain no such chunks.
The semantic branch of both hybrids retains its original metadata-aware ranking.
Latency uses warm serial queries on one machine; no production throughput claim.
No embedding cache: hybrid latency includes a semantic query embedding.
Relevance labels are sparse and this dataset is too small to establish general superiority.
selection_policy: maximize Recall@K, then nDCG@K, MRR@K and Precision@K; ties retained
